notes.title: Update: New Chinese Translation + Custom Music Support
notes.notes: [p]We've just updated the game with a new and improved Chinese translation, thanks to feedback from our players. If you previously had issues with the Chinese in-game text and story, this update should offer a much better experience.[/p][p]In addition, the music player now supports custom tracks. You can upload your own music and listen to it directly in-game via the music player or settings menu.[/p][p]Thanks for all the feedback and support! We're continuing to make improvements with each update, so let us know how the new features are working for you![/p]

notes.title: v1.0.0 Hotfix Update Released!
notes.notes:
Thanks for the quick feedback after release! Here's what’s been fixed and improved in this update:

[list]
[*] Added a "Story" category for characters
[*] Improved translations for Italian, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, German, and Polish
[*] Reduced particle effects for Expell and Lactation scenes
[*] Fixed Steam icon not displaying correctly
[*] Changed Autopilot Knotting behavior — now reduces arousal to prevent spamming
[*] Fixed Autopilot rounding issue
[*] Resolved performance issue when opening custom dialogue window
[*] Tweaked resolution settings behavior
[*] Fixed Toys widget requiring two clicks to open the first time
[*] Fixed Toys getting stuck
[*] Fixed Nipple Vibes not being removable
[*] Fixed backgrounds not updating correctly in non-English languages
[*] Fixed Condom not preventing pregnancy as intended
[*] Fixed achievement unlocks at the end of storylines — if you’ve already completed them, they will now unlock on game start
[/list]

Let us know if your issue has been addressed or if there's anything we should look into—thanks for helping us improve!

notes.title: v1.0.0 is getting closer! - Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve been continuing our big UI overhaul, and today I wanted to share some updates on what’s been improved and what’s coming together behind the scenes!

✨ Updated UI Highlights:
We’ve made refinements to a few key areas to improve the overall user experience:

Main Menu – cleaned up the layout and visuals for a smoother start

Sandbox Intro – better UX for navigating and accessing scenes

Settings Menu – more intuitive design and easier to use across platforms

🛠️ Ongoing UI Rework:
We’ve also pushed forward with more polish in several in-game areas:

Loading Screen – now with a cleaner, more consistent look

Confirmation Window – redesigned for clarity and readability

Actions Menu (top-left in Sandbox) – more accessible and less cluttered

Auto Pilot + Handkerchief buttons – merged into a single, easy-to-access menu on the middle right

Arousal & Orgasm UI – now combined into a single visual element per character, found at the bottom right

Music Player Menu – redesigned for better usability and aesthetics

🐞 Bug Fixes:
Fixed Uke’s front arm position in the Standing scene

Fixed visual glitches affecting some character/scene assets

As always, thank you so much for the continued support and feedback. These improvements are all driven by the community's input, and it’s helping us build something truly polished and immersive. We’re getting closer to that final experience!

More updates soon! 💜

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Our demo was just updated with our latest features, CONDOMS! 😄 This will be our last update of the demo before our full official v1.0 of the game. If you’ve been curious about the game, now’s the perfect time to try it out and get a first taste of the story, characters, and romance we have in store for you. Your feedback will help us fine-tune the experience before launch, making the final release that much better.

If you enjoyed it, don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam—it helps a ton! And if you know someone who’d love Lust’s Cupid, feel free to share it with them. Every bit of support means the world!
